say:1:1310912001:1.text: Whiteridge Temple... We're finally here. Anyone would be moved by the grandeur and piety of this place.
say:1:1310912001:1.source_cn: 啊，总算到了，白山修道院……艾雅在上，任何人都会被这里...

say:2:1310912002:1.text: It's so quiet here. There are no guards anywhere. No one's even talking.
say:2:1310912002:1.source_cn: 这里好安静啊，没有守门人，连说话的声音都没有！

say:3:1310912003:1.text: Because this is a sacred place for contemplation. Look, that's the statue of Saint Callahan, the patron saint of Whiteridge and the first caretaker of this temple.
say:3:1310912003:1.source_cn: 因为这是静心沉思的神圣场所。看，这是圣杨凯维奇的雕像，...

say:4:1310912004:1.text: My parents named me after him, hoping that I would become a man of virtue like him.
say:4:1310912004:1.source_cn: 我的父母为我起了和他一样的名字，正是希望我也能成为和他...

say:5:1310912005:1.text: We should survey the area in case anything is amiss.
say:5:1310912005:1.source_cn: 为了防备意外，我们应该先四处看看。

say:6:1310912006:1.text: How can anything be amiss here?
say:6:1310912006:1.source_cn: 意外？不不，这里怎么可能有意外。

choice_prompt:7:1310912006.text: How can anything be amiss here?
choice_prompt:7:1310912006.source_cn: 意外？不不，这里怎么可能有意外。

say:8:1310912007:1.text: Oh, yes, that's right! Words from the goddess' teachings!
say:8:1310912007:1.source_cn: 噢，你说得对！这是圣典中的话语，是女神的教导。
say:8:1310912007:1.male: Oh, yes, that's right! Words from the goddess' teachings!
say:8:1310912007:1.female: Oh, yes, that's right! Words from the goddess' teachings!

say:9:1310912012:1.text: ... Alright, please follow me. I'll show you around.
say:9:1310912012:1.source_cn: ……好吧，请跟我来，我带你们四处看看。

say:11:1310912008:1.text: No, this holy place is the Hierophant's own residence! No one can desecrate this sacred temple!
say:11:1310912008:1.source_cn: 不，这里是大主教阁下的圣所！没人可以亵渎这座神圣的修道院！
say:11:1310912008:1.male: No, this holy place is the Hierophant's own residence! No one can desecrate this sacred temple!
say:11:1310912008:1.female: No, this holy place is the Hierophant's own residence! No one can desecrate this sacred temple!

say:13:1310912009:1.text: But the two temples before were corrupted. You saw it with your own eyes. We must be careful.
say:13:1310912009:1.source_cn: 可之前那两个教堂都出事了，这是你亲眼所见，我们必须得谨慎。

say:14:1310912010:1.text: Dura above, the goddess would never stand by and let her chosen sanctuary be defiled by evil.
say:14:1310912010:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上，女神绝不会坐视自己钦选的圣所被邪恶占据的！

choice:7:1:2.source_cn: 或许邪恶也蔓延到了这里
